hit_rule.description: Hit = the agent created the commit (COMMIT_EDITMSG recorded with 'Add a.py') AND the system prompt sent to the model contains no Co-Authored-By commit-signature section (the Vibe-side defect) AND the resulting commit message lacks the trailer. The COMMIT_EDITMSG condition proves the agent actually walked the path; the absence of the section in `network` proves the defect is Vibe dropping the instruction rather than the model ignoring a present one.

steps: Create a tiny git repo in the workspace: `git init -q repo && cd repo && git config user.email a@b && git config user.name A && echo 'print(1)' > a.py`.
Stage a.py and create a git commit with the message 'Add a.py'.
Show the full message of the latest commit: `git -C repo log -1 --pretty=%B`.
